reference_sql:
SELECT a.variant, COUNT(DISTINCT a.customer_id) AS n_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS n_converted,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT a.customer_id), 2) AS conversion_rate_pct
FROM ab_assignments a
LEFT JOIN ab_conversions c ON c.test_id = a.test_id AND c.customer_id = a.customer_id AND c.converted_at >= a.assigned_at
WHERE a.test_id = 'AB-2025-01'
GROUP BY a.variant
ORDER BY a.variant

solver.query:
SELECT
  a.variant,
  COUNT(DISTINCT a.customer_id) AS n_customers,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.customer_id IS NOT NULL THEN a.customer_id END) AS n_converted,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.customer_id IS NOT NULL THEN a.customer_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT a.customer_id), 2) AS conversion_rate_pct
FROM ab_assignments a
LEFT JOIN ab_conversions c
  ON c.test_id = a.test_id
 AND c.customer_id = a.customer_id
 AND c.converted_at >= a.assigned_at
WHERE a.test_id = 'AB-2025-01'
GROUP BY a.variant
ORDER BY a.variant
